primary_task: Create a new skill folder (SKILL.md with frontmatter, optional scripts/references/assets) for a user-described skill, initialized with init_skill.py and checked with quick_validate.py.

requirements.name: python3
requirements.basis: bash: run shell commands on Linux x86_64 ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts

requirements.name: bundled scripts init_skill.py, quick_validate.py, generate_openai_yaml.py
requirements.evidence: When creating a new skill from scratch, always run the `init_skill.py` script.
requirements.basis: Manifest does not say whether the skill's bundled scripts are present; need to check the skill directory is installed

requirements.name: write/edit files
requirements.evidence: Edit the skill (implement resources and write SKILL.md)

requirements.name: PyYAML (likely used by validator)
requirements.basis: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)

requirements.name: user answers about concrete usage examples
requirements.evidence: Understand the skill with concrete examples ... 'What functionality should the image-editor skill support?'
requirements.basis: ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation

notes: The bundled scripts' presence is unknown; if absent the author could still write SKILL.md by hand, so I did not treat it as blocking. 'Codex' wording is text only.
